entities.name: Krystyna Pawłowicz
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Krystyna Pawłowicz is a Polish jurist and political figure. In the years 2007–2011, Pawłowicz was a Justice of the State Tribunal. She was a member of the Sejm and was part of the National Council of the Judiciary. Pawłowicz was a judge of the Constitutional Tribunal from 5 December 2019 to 5 December 2025. She has taught at the University of Warsaw and the School of Public Administration in Ostrołęka.

entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Krystyna Pawłowicz is a Polish jurist and political figure. In the years 2007–2011, Pawłowicz was a Justice of the State Tribunal. She was a member of the Sejm and was part of the National Council of the Judiciary. Pawłowicz was a judge of the Constitutional Tribunal from 5 December 2019 to 5 December 2025. She has taught at the University of Warsaw and the School of Public Administration in Ostrołęka.
